description: This file is a shell script used for testing git pack index functionalities, including pack creation, verification, and handling of legacy index versions, 64-bit offsets, and corruption scenarios.

methods.name: index_obj_nr
methods.description: Returns the object number for a given object SHA1 in the specified pack index file.

methods.name: index_obj_offset
methods.description: Returns the offset of a specified object SHA1 within the pack index file.
